title: skills: objectstack-ui list-views does not teach the new board settings (summary, showFieldLabels, hideEmptyFields)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36370 (PR #36411, kanban gets its own view settings). The PR's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line names this. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36370.

## What happens

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` teaches the board view through an example that uses `summarizeField`. After #36411 the board view also takes `summary`, `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields`, and the skill teaches none of them. An agent that follows the skill keeps writing the old shape and never sets the new ones.

## To do

1. Rewrite the board example to the keys #36411 lands, with one line each on what `summary`, `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields` do and their defaults.
2. Check the skill's other references for `summarizeField` on a board and align them.

## Acceptance

- The skill's board example uses every board key #36411 adds, and no sentence contradicts the spec's describe text.

Blocked-by: #36411

## Grade
p2 · domain:skills. Teaching drift, not broken.
